name: text-reveal
title: Text Reveal
blurb: Words fade in one by one as the page scrolls past this double-height section.
description: Takes a string and splits it into words, each revealing via scroll-linked opacity animation. Component spans 200vh height with sticky positioning.
use_when: Long-form narrative sections where text should unfold gradually as the reader scrolls through.
avoid_when: Mobile with scrolling by tap; does not work well with scroll-jacking. Requires a string input, not rich content.
a11y: Text is fully rendered in the DOM and readable; opacity animation responds to prefers-reduced-motion implicitly via scroll interaction.
